patches.title: Return to Surfaces After Container Miss
patches.principle: If a container does not hold the target, resume scanning open surfaces before opening more containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When you open a container and the target is not inside.

patches.title: Avoid Sink Without Target Object
patches.principle: Only move to the sink if you are already holding the object that needs cleaning.
patches.when_to_apply: When you consider going to sink while not holding a dirty object.
